sentences.text:
The instant misc. petition has been filed by the petitioner for quashing of Fir
No.163/2022, Police Station Pratap Nagar Sadar, District Jodhpur City East for offences under
Sections 403, 406, 420, 424, 467, 468, 471 and 120-B of Ipc.

Learned Public Prosecutor has submitted a report dated 20.03.2023 received from the SHO, Police Station Pratap Nagar Sadar, District Jodhpur City East wherein it has been mentioned that Police is going to submit a Final Report in this case.
The said report is hereby taken on record.
In view of the aforesaid facts and circumstances, the present misc. petition has become infructuous and dismissed accordingly.
